messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: increased 5xx rate for svc-inference (22% ↑ in 2m). Canary deployment 17980 in progress.

deploy-bot: Started rolling deploy inference-service (image=inference:v2.14). Canary=5 pods, step=1/5.

alice_oncall: I'm seeing customer 502/500 errors. Pausing rollout and taking lead. @bob_sre can you look at pod status?

alice_oncall: kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=svc-inference-canary -o wide
```
NAME                                      READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
svc-inference-canary-5a2b                 0/2     CrashLoopBackOff   4          2m
svc-inference-canary-6c3d                 1/2     Running            0          1m
svc-inference-canary-7d9f                 0/2     Init:Error         1          30s
```

bob_sre: grabbing logs from init container on svc-inference-canary-5a2b
```
I0330 12:34:10 init.go:45] allocate cache
fatal error: runtime: out of memory
goroutine 1 [running]:
runtime.throw(0x...)

SIGKILL
```

bob_sre: Init hook in v2.14 now preloads a large shard of model metadata; default config increased memory footprint. Init is OOM'ing and crashing the pod -> readiness never true -> requests routed to failing pods -> 5xx.

carol_pm: CS is seeing errors too, what's the customer impact? @liz_cs

liz_cs: Multiple enterprise customers in EU hit 502s, created INC-8123. ~140 failed req/min at peak, first reports 12:33 UTC. Outreach started to top 10.

alice_oncall: Paused rollout via deployctl: `deployctl pause rollout 17980` and flipped kill-switch flag for canary routes: `featureflag set inference_canary_cutover false`.

alice_oncall: Initiating rollback to previous stable image: `redwood-deploy rollback inference-service --to=17979`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for inference-service. Traffic routing switching back to stable pool.

ops_ryan: Also noticed an HPA cooldown bug: canary minReplicas=0 in the manifest for v2.14 which allowed aggressive scale-in, combined with init memory pressure caused node eviction noise. I'll patch HPA to minReplicas=2 once rollback finishes.

bob_sre: After rollback, new pods on stable image are healthy and 5xx rate falling. Watching metrics for 10m. Will strip the init preload in a follow-up PR and add memory caps to init container.

alice_oncall: Filed follow-up: PR to make init preload opt-in + add init resource limits. Tagged incident INC-8123 with canary, inithook, OOM, rollback.

maria_oncall: ACK — taking handoff in 20m. I'll monitor the dashboard and coordinate with CS for any follow-ups.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8123 created and assigned to alice_oncall. Severity: P1 (customer-impact). Tags: canary, inithook, OOM, rollback, HPA

alice_oncall: Summary for handoff: paused rollout, flipped canary kill-switch, rolled back to 17979, HPA patch queued, CS notified. Next steps: revert init preload or add memory/cgroup caps, add unit test for HPA manifest, run warmup in staging.

maria_oncall: ACK — will clear page once 5xx back to baseline for 30m and CS confirms mitigation.
_meta: generated for dataset: incident thread about a canary deploy with init hook causing OOMs, rollback and handoff
